verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Summer Engine acting as an MCP server for external agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Hermes. It configures those agents and ships tools like summer_docs_search. Nothing shows Summer itself accepting or connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Since Summer has its own built-in AI builder, an MCP-client capability is a fair question, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
